responsibility: Declares the HIR visitor used by the Rust frontend’s second readonly-assignment checking pass. The ReadonlyChecker interface ties together resolver, HIR mapping, and type-check context state; exposes the crate-level go(HIR::Crate&) entry point; defines the assignment-context stack used while analyzing lvalue subexpressions; and declares the visit hooks and helper routines for assignment expressions, paths, projections, dereferences, let-pattern initialization tracking, and immutable-variable checking that the companion source file implements.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ReadonlyChecker class and its visitor/helper entry points for the second readonly-check pass, plus the resolver, mapping, type-check, and mutable-context members it depends on, whereas the same-stem .cc file contains the concrete traversal, assignment-tracking, and error-emission implementation.
